reason: I have already been burned by clunky software like Jamku that my team abandoned after two months, so I will not commit ₹12,990 upfront. More critically, I need rock-solid proof that connecting Google Drive won't expose my firm's private client files to an outside platform.
objection: Will connecting my Google Drive give Docketra access to read all my firm's private files?
would_change_my_mind: Verifying on the free pilot that OAuth permissions are strictly confined to the /Docketra/ folder without any access to the rest of my Drive, and seeing it genuinely help my 10 PM ROC reviews.
